chunks: "Hold your beard with your hand and trim what exceeds."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about trimming the beard?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs a manner of grooming the beard by taking it in the hand and trimming what extends beyond that. It reflects teachings on cleanliness, presentability, and personal etiquette in Shia hadith literature.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.334 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
said: "Hold your beard with your hand (in a fist) and trim what is excess."
